name: Allenby Road Reserve
parent_tip: There is shelter on site, with picnic areas, BBQ facilities and seating. A drinking fountain is also available.

name: Altezze Drive Reserve
parent_tip: There is shelter on site, with BBQs and picnic tables. Pathways and bike facilities help everyone get there easily.

name: Aintree Town Centre Reserve
parent_tip: There is shelter on site, with seating and a drinking fountain. The water play was turned off for winter and resumes later in 2026 as the warm weather returns.

name: Anghor Drive Reserve
parent_tip: There is shelter on site, with picnic areas and plenty of seating. A shared path and bike station support walking and riding, while a drinking fountain adds comfort for longer visits.

name: Angul Parade Reserve
parent_tip: There is shelter on site, with a BBQ and picnic areas. Basketball facilities and open space suit an active afternoon.

name: Aintree Recreation Reserve
parent_tip: Frontier Park sits within this reserve, which has an on-site car park and shelter. Check the signs on arrival, as the playground tower roof is being repaired in two stages and the water play park closes during stage two.

name: Isabella Williams Memorial Reserve
parent_tip: Off-street car parking is available, along with shade shelters and barbecues. The reserve is also accessible by foot or by bike via the Kororoit Creek Trail.

name: Buckingham Reserve
parent_tip: A new car park serves the reserve, reached along an entry boulevard lined with deciduous maples. Shelter, BBQ facilities and toilets are also available.

name: Sunvale Park
parent_tip: There is a large shelter on site, with BBQ facilities, a water play area and a skate park. Public toilets and exercise equipment are also available.

name: Brimbank Park
parent_tip: Sheltered picnic areas with free gas barbecues are available, and car parks A, B and C serve the park. The park opens at 6.00am and closes at 5.30pm in winter and 8.00pm during daylight saving.

name: Organ Pipes National Park
parent_tip: Park your car on top of an old volcano, then walk down into the river valley to the stone columns. Note the initial walk from the carpark is down a short but very steep hill.

name: Werribee Gorge State Park
parent_tip: Access is by vehicle only, with picnic areas at Meikles Point and Quarry. Early morning hikes in the warmer seasons can be rewarded with a rockpool paddle.

name: Melton Waves Leisure Centre
parent_tip: Melton Waves has on-site parking, but spaces can fill during peak times such as weekend mornings and after-school swim sessions. Allow a little extra time at those busy times.

name: Brimbank Aquatic and Wellness Centre swim school
parent_tip: Parking is near the entrance. Time your visit around the waterslides, which run Monday to Friday 4pm to 7pm and weekends 10am to 5pm, with longer hours in school holidays.

name: Preschool Storytime, Caroline Springs Library
parent_tip: Storytime runs Wednesdays 10am to 10.30am at Caroline Springs Library during school terms. Regular programs do not run on public holidays or during school holidays, and bookings are not required.

name: Toddler Time, Melton City Libraries
parent_tip: Toddler Time runs Fridays 10am to 10.30am and 11am to 11.30am at Caroline Springs, and Mondays and Thursdays 10am to 10.30am at Melton Library. Sessions run weekly during school terms, excluding public holidays, and bookings are not required.

name: Make Your Own 3D Pizza with 3D Printing (ages 6–10)
Melton City Council Vacation Care
parent_tip: Vacation Care runs during Victorian school holidays, Monday to Friday 7am to 6pm. Details of the summer program, including dates and booking details, will be released soon, so check the council page before booking.

name: Get Activated multi-sport morning (past event, summer repeat TBC)
Melton Youth Holiday Activities
parent_tip: Youth Holiday Activities run during school holidays for young people aged 12 to 25 years. Activity information is released in the lead-up to each term's holidays, with bookings made online at the specified time.

name: Code Camp
parent_tip: Drop-off is between 9.00 and 9.30am, and pick-up is between 3.30 and 4.00pm. Extended hours from 8.30am to 5.00pm are available at certain locations.

name: TeamKids
parent_tip: TeamKids Vacation Care runs Monday to Friday, except on public holidays. Children must be signed in no later than 9am each day and can be collected from approximately 4pm onwards.

name: Werribee Open Range Zoo
parent_tip: Free parking is available for visitors, with parking attendants guiding you in during peak times like school and public holidays. The zoo is open daily 9am to 5pm, with last entry at 3.30pm.

name: Scienceworks
parent_tip: Scienceworks is open daily 10am to 4.30pm. For a quieter visit, low sensory sessions run on the first Saturday of each month, and 3 to 4.30pm on Saturdays is traditionally a quiet period.

name: SuperPark Highpoint
parent_tip: There is plenty of parking, with loads of spaces close to the entrances. Enter the car park off Warrs Road, from the roundabout at Warrs Road and Horizon Drive.

name: Amphitheatre Street Reserve
parent_tip: Sheltered seating and picnic facilities make this a comfortable spot for a picnic or quick play. A shared path suits walking or riding, and a drinking fountain is available.

name: Arbour Boulevard Central Reserve
parent_tip: An upgrade adding sheltered picnic spaces, diverse play equipment and an outdoor gym was due to start in early June 2026, so check for works on arrival. The park currently has play equipment, a shared path and seating areas.

name: Bridge Road Recreation Reserve and Regional Play Space
parent_tip: The reserve has an on-site car park, and shared paths and shelter provide space for families to gather. Picnic areas and a BBQ are also available.

name: Hannah Watts Park
parent_tip: A public shelter provides shade, and there is an on-site car park. Generous picnic shelters have wheelchair-accessible barbecues, tables and a drinking fountain.

name: Lake Caroline Waterfront
parent_tip: There is an on-site car park at The Esplanade, Caroline Springs. Picnic facilities include a BBQ, benches and tables for longer visits by the water.

name: Melton Swim School (at Genesis Fitness Melton)
parent_tip: There are 120 car spaces available on site at Genesis Fitness Melton. Lessons run seven days a week, with 30-minute lessons for children and adults.

name: Baby Bounce, Melton City Libraries
parent_tip: Baby Bounce runs Tuesdays 10am to 10.30am and Wednesdays 11.30am to 12pm at Caroline Springs, and Tuesdays and Wednesdays 11.30am to 12pm at Melton Library. Sessions run every week during school terms, and bookings are not required.

name: After Schooligans, Melton City Libraries
parent_tip: After Schooligans runs Tuesdays 3.45pm to 4.30pm at both Melton and Caroline Springs libraries during school terms. Bookings are not required.

name: Family Tales, Melton City Libraries
parent_tip: Family Tales runs one Saturday a month, 11am to 11.30am, at Caroline Springs and Melton libraries. Regular programs do not run on public holidays or during school holidays.

name: Burnside Busy Kids Playgroup
parent_tip: Burnside Busy Kids runs Mondays 10.30am to 12pm at Burnside Children's and Community Centre. All families with children aged 0 to 5 years are welcome.

name: YMCA Kororoit Creek Playgroup
parent_tip: YMCA Kororoit Creek Playgroup runs Tuesdays 10am to 12pm during school terms. It meets at 5 Millport Drive, Burnside Heights.

name: Diggers Rest Playgroup
parent_tip: Diggers Rest Playgroup runs Thursdays 10am to 12pm in school terms only. It meets at Diggers Rest Sports and Community Pavilion, on the corner of Plumpton Road and Houdini Drive.

name: Mums and Bubs Playgroup, Plumpton Children's & Community Centre
parent_tip: Mums and Bubs Playgroup runs Tuesdays 12.30pm to 2pm at Plumpton Children's and Community Centre. The playgroup offers a welcoming space indoors and outdoors where children can explore and learn.

name: Melton Enjoy Playgroup
parent_tip: Melton Enjoy Playgroup runs Thursdays 10am to 11.30am at 11 Navigation Drive, Melton. Entry is free, with free coffee and tea and free arts and crafts.

name: Botanica Springs Playgroup
parent_tip: Botanica Springs Playgroup runs Thursdays 9.30am to 11.30am in school terms only. It meets at Botanica Springs Children's and Community Centre, 249 Clarkes Road, Brookfield.

name: Melton West Primary School Playgroup
parent_tip: Melton West Primary School Playgroup runs Tuesdays 8.50am to 11am and Wednesdays 8.50am to 12pm. It meets at Melton West Primary School, 2-16 Rathdowne Circuit, Melton West.

name: Arnolds Creek Grandparents Playgroup
parent_tip: Arnolds Creek Grandparents Playgroup runs Fridays 9.30am to 11am. It meets at Arnolds Creek Children's and Community Centre, Claret Ash Boulevard, Harkness.

name: Gather and Grow Playgroup
parent_tip: Gather and Grow Playgroup runs Tuesdays 10am to 11.30am all year round, including school holidays. It is free, meets at 52 Dorchester Street, Thornhill Park, and morning tea is provided for all families.

name: PlayConnect Playgroup
parent_tip: PlayConnect Playgroup runs Tuesdays 10am to 12pm in school terms only. It is a free, safe and supported playgroup for children aged 0 to 5 years with autism, developmental delays or behavioural concerns.

name: Rhyme Time, Truganina Library Lounge
parent_tip: Rhyme Time runs Tuesdays and Wednesdays 10.30am to 11am at Truganina Community Centre, 1 Everton Road. Sessions are free and for children aged 1 to 5 years.

name: Baby Time, Truganina Library Lounge
parent_tip: Baby Time runs Wednesdays 2.30pm and Thursdays 10.30am at Truganina Library Lounge. The 30-minute sessions are for babies aged 12 months or younger, and you can stay for play afterwards.

name: Multicultural Playgroup, Truganina Community Centre
parent_tip: Multicultural Playgroup runs Mondays 10am to 12pm at Truganina Community Centre, 1 Everton Road. It is free and for migrant and refugee families in Wyndham.

name: FLIP Gymnastics Holiday Program (Truganina)
parent_tip: FLIP's Truganina holiday sessions run on Mondays, 9.30am to 2pm. Spots are limited, so book early to secure a place.

name: Hillside Recreation Reserve
parent_tip: There is an on-site car park, and a large shelter area with barbecue facilities suits picnics and birthdays. You can also relax on the grass under shady trees.

name: Broughton Avenue Reserve
parent_tip: The water play is for warmer days, so save this park for hot weather. On a warm day the kids can cool off while you relax at the picnic facilities.

name: Kurunjang Recreation Reserve
parent_tip: The car park makes access easy, and there is a public shelter on site. Benches, seats and a drinking fountain are also available.

name: Frontier Park (Aintree Recreation Reserve)
parent_tip: There is an on-site car park and shelter, with picnic facilities and a BBQ. Check the signs on arrival, as the playground tower roof is being repaired in two stages and the water play park closes during stage two.

name: Barwon Street Reserve
parent_tip: The playspace upgrade is complete and the reserve is open to the public. The upgrade improved the picnic area and increased tree planting around the park.

name: Mainview Boulevard Reserve
parent_tip: Availability may be limited in the evenings and on weekends, when tenant sporting clubs have ongoing allocations. The reserve has a playground, BBQ facilities and a public toilet for community use.

name: Alcock Road Reserve
parent_tip: Availability may be limited in the evenings and on weekends, when tenant sporting clubs have ongoing allocations. The reserve has a playground, BBQ facilities and a public toilet for community use.

name: YMCA Taylors Hill School Holiday Program
parent_tip: Bookings are now open for the summer school holiday program, running Monday to Friday 6.30am to 6.30pm. Note there is no program on 24 and 25 December or on the 26 January public holiday.

name: Melton City Libraries school holiday program
Bullion Park
parent_tip: Shelter and BBQs make this an easy spot for a family picnic. Shared paths and plenty of open space suit a quick game or a longer stay.

name: Mawson Gardens
parent_tip: There is an on-site car park, and shelter is available. Picnic facilities include a BBQ, benches, seats and tables.

name: Cypress Views Village Park
parent_tip: A public shelter provides shade, with extra shade from recent tree plantings. Picnic facilities include a BBQ, benches, seats and tables.

name: St Georges Avenue Reserve
parent_tip: Extra shade comes from tree plantings added in the 2026 play space upgrade. The upgraded play space has a new multiplay unit with slides, a basket climbing structure and swings.

name: Taylors Hill Central Park
parent_tip: Most of the playground is protected by shade sails, with BBQs, picnic tables and a drinking fountain. An upgrade adding sheltered picnic spaces and waterplay was due to start in mid-2026, so check for works on arrival.

name: Parkwood Green Reserve
parent_tip: There is an on-site car park, and shelter is available. Adults can relax at the BBQ area or in the park seating while kids use the playground.

name: Arnolds Creek Recreation Reserve
parent_tip: Parking is available on site, and an abundance of trees provides natural shade. Picnic facilities around the play equipment include a shelter, BBQ and tables.

name: Norm Raven Reserve
parent_tip: There is an on-site car park and shelter, with picnic facilities including a BBQ. Note the playground is closed for an upgrade until its expected completion in November 2026, so check before visiting.

name: Rhyme Time, Point Cook Library
parent_tip: Rhyme Time runs Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Fridays 9.30am at Point Cook Library. The 30-minute sessions are for children aged 1 to 5 years.

name: Story Time, Point Cook Library
parent_tip: Story Time runs Tuesdays 11am and Fridays 11am at Point Cook Library. The 45-minute sessions include stories, rhymes and craft for children aged 3 to 5 years.

name: Stockland Point Cook playgroup (Wyndham City)
parent_tip: Stockland Point Cook playgroup runs Thursdays 10am to 11.30am. It is a free drop-in session with no registration or enrolment required.
